relations: If a blue flame flickers beneath the left burner, its intermittent heat drives the thin oil film to shift.
The irregular oil boundary undulates as the liquid moves, its upper edge creeping rightward into the darker zone.
The bright white reflection along the far-right edge persists while the griddle surface stays largely fixed.
Grate bars and burner caps below the front rim remain stationary throughout the flickering and oil motion.
caption: The video captures a close, high-angle view of a flat black griddle on a gas stovetop, its left surface coated with a dull oil sheen bounded by an irregular edge while the right stays darker. A bright white reflection glows along the far-right edge, and the stove's grate bars and burner caps sit fixed below the front rim. Apart from minor jitter, the griddle and reflection remain largely fixed, with no clear translation. Beneath the left burner, a blue gas flame flickers intermittently. It fades in and out repeatedly rather than igniting once or dying out. The irregular boundary of the oil film undulates slightly, its upper edge creeping rightward as the thin liquid shifts on the surface. The motion is underway and continues.
